description: This file defines the class 'EmailsNonImportedDetailView', a specialized view class extending 'EmailsDetailView' for displaying detailed email information for non-imported emails within SuiteCRM. It includes setup configurations and logic for populating bean data based on inbound email records, with focus on handling non-imported email details.

classes.name: EmailsNonImportedDetailView
classes.description: A subclass of EmailsDetailView tailored for non-imported email detail views, with customized setup and bean population logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the view with given module, focus object, metadata, template, and filename parameters, calling the parent setup method.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the bean object with inbound email data if request parameters 'uid', 'inbound_email_record', and 'msgno' are provided, using InboundEmail bean; logs errors if inbound email cannot be found.
